whySwitch.title: Why cross-border and performance teams move from ZWIZ.AI to Cluega IM

items.title: Fill the gap the Pixel funnel misses and feed the ad algorithm precise signals
items.body: ZWIZ's data stops at the interaction layer — how many replies, what got clicked. Cluega IM writes real L5／L6 private-domain sales back to Meta／TikTok (CAPI), filling in the private-domain conversions platform Pixels can't measure, so the algorithm receives a genuine "audiences who pay" signal and gets sharper the longer you run.

items.title: Cross-platform identity merging, so one buyer is never billed twice
items.body: A customer arrives via LINE, then reappears on WhatsApp／Zalo? Cluega IM merges that buyer's cross-channel footprint at the identity layer (Identity Merge): conversation history is unified and the sale counts once, so attribution and billing are never duplicated or inflated.

items.title: Reconnect the conversation and sales chain that "can't be tracked individually"
items.body: After Click-to-Message, the platform can't see the person any more — that's exactly the private-domain black box. Cluega IM reads the semantics of each conversation, pinpoints the sales stage and reconnects the entire chain from ad click to DM sale, making the downstream fate of every ad completely clear.

items.title: Outcome-based billing, perfectly aligned interests
items.body: Compared with fixed packages that bundle implementation services, Cluega IM charges a performance fee only when the AI genuinely pushes a conversation into the sales tier; high-volume conversations that don't convert only carry a base fee covering compute. We earn when you earn — a promise hard-coded into the billing structure.

zwiz.body: You need a Thai-language chatbot, Rich Menu and points marketing live quickly, you prefer a one-off package with implementation handled by the vendor, and interaction plus support automation is the whole goal.

cluega.label: Choose Cluega IM
cluega.body: You're buying Meta／TikTok／LINE ads and need sales-level attribution: which ad produced conversations that actually paid, cross-channel buyers counted once, performance data written back to platforms to scale spend — with outcome-based billing that aligns the platform's interests with yours.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you might want to know before you reach out to our team.

items.q: We already run LINE OA on ZWIZ.AI — do we still need Cluega IM?
items.a: They run side by side perfectly well. ZWIZ keeps owning interaction and support automation while Cluega IM takes over the attribution layer: pushing conversation progress, captured leads and closed sales back to the ad source. When your goal upgrades from "reply fast" to "attribute right", Cluega IM is the missing piece.

items.q: Will Cluega IM affect our existing ZWIZ.AI bot setup?
items.a: No. Cluega IM connects through the channels' official APIs and is compatible with your existing Rich Menu and auto-reply rules; you can pilot attribution on a single channel first and expand the managed scope step by step.

items.q: How do ZWIZ.AI and Cluega IM differ on ad data?
items.a: ZWIZ gives you interaction metrics (message volume, clicks, comments); Cluega IM gives you sales attribution — every L5／L6 sale points back to campaign／adset／creative, and true ROAS is computed at sales-stage granularity. The former measures noise, the latter measures business.

items.q: How does Cluega IM handle buyers across channels (say LINE and Zalo)?
items.a: The same customer is counted per channel for conversations but merged at the identity layer: conversation history and sales events land in a single profile, one sale counts once and is billed once, and it still points back to the original ad source.
